description.value: Friends Campground is one of four campgrounds within Kokanee Creek Provincial Park on Kootenay Lake, 19 km east of Nelson off paved Hwy 3A, with access to over a kilometre of sandy beach, old-growth cedar canyon trails, and a kokanee spawning channel; full amenities including showers, e-bike charging, and electrical hook-ups make it comfortable, but it is a heavily visited summer destination that books out fast.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Friends Campground is one of four campgrounds within Kokanee Creek Provincial Park and explicitly states it offers 13 vehicle-accessible campsites with electrical hookups, corroborating OSM's power_supply=yes; OSM's capacity=38 appears to reflect the broader park rather than Friends Campground alone. Reservations are confirmed via the BC Parks frontcountry camping page referencing camping.bcparks.ca. The OSM phone number (+1-250-825-4212) cannot be confirmed from the website, which lists 250-825-4723 for the nature centre and a different toll-free number for BC Parks central.
concerns: OSM capacity=38 likely reflects the entire Kokanee Creek Park (four campgrounds), not Friends Campground specifically; the website states Friends Campground has only 13 sites.
OSM internet_access=no conflicts with the website, which notes WiFi is available at the Kokanee Creek nature centre within the park (seasonal, mid-May to mid-September).

OSM phone +1-250-825-4212 is not confirmed by the website; the website lists 250-825-4723 for the nature centre and 1-800-689-9025 for BC Parks central — the OSM number may be the park operator (RAP Park Contracting Ltd.) but cannot be verified.
No physical address in OSM; park is on Hwy 3A, 19 km east of Nelson.
The website URL covers all of Kokanee Creek Park; Friends Campground-specific amenity details (showers, potable water, etc.) are not broken out.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established BC provincial park campground with electrical hookups near the popular cycling hub of Nelson; a clear fit for touring cyclists exploring the West Kootenays.
enrichment_extras.notes: The seasonal Kokanee Creek nature centre within the park offers WiFi access, a coffee shop, and a gift shop (mid-May to mid-September); contact number 250-825-4723.

wow_evidence: over a kilometre of sandy beach... showers, e-bike charging
